competencies: A confident person who has a strong sense of right and wrong, thinks independently and creatively, and communicates effectively.
A self-directed individual who takes responsibility for his/her learning, questions reflects and perseveres for lifelong learning.
An active contributor who can work effectively in teams, takes calculated risks, is innovative to produce goods and services, and strives for excellence.
A concerned citizen who is well rooted in our society, is responsible to the family, to the community, to the nation and the globe, and takes an active role in improving the lives of others.
attitudes: Positive attitude towards vocational hands-on work

topics.core_competency: The learner responds to and makes simple requests about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life. He/she reads, understands and analyses texts to create cultural awareness about Ugandan and Chinese culture.

learning_outcomes.outcome_text: understand and use relevant vocabulary about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
listen to and understand dialogues and texts about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
briefly introduce somebody else’s friends.
understand and talk about the etiquette in interpersonal relationships and how to make friends.
read and understand the gist of the dialogues and texts about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
express him/herself in writing by writing a short essay related to interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
understand and use some idioms related to interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
form a basic understanding of the translation of texts about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.

suggested_learning_activities.description: in groups, identifies and discusses the main ideas in the dialogue about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
listens to a dialogue about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life and writes the key words he/she hears.
reads a text and fills in the blanks in a text about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
Watches a video of a student giving a speech about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life in a competition in Chinese.
rearranges the words/phrases to construct sentences about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
reads a passage about relationships and shares his/her opinion.
writes a short composition introducing somebody else’s friend in relation to interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
writes a brief paragraph about his/her interpersonal relationship and dormitory experience, and translates it into Chinese.

suggested_assessment_activities.description: Observe the learner as he/she writes and recites the keywords and sentences he/she hears in the dialogue about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life.
Observe the learner as he/she reads an extract about interpersonal relationships and dormitory life and respond to questions about it.
Observe and gauge the learner’s ability to watch, listen to and understand a video of a student giving a speech in Chinese language and his/her ability to retell it.
Listen to and gauge the learner’s ability to give a speech fluently about his/her dormitory life and make suggestions for improvement on pronunciation.
Observe the learner while he/she writes a brief paragraph about his/her interpersonal relationship and dormitory experience and observe how he/she also translates it into Chinese.

assessment_weightings.notes_verbatim: School-based assessment will contribute 20% and the end-of-cycle assessment 80% to the overall score of the learner at the end of the two-year course.

topic_metadata.topic_title: The Impact of the Media on People's Lives

topics.core_competency: The learner uses Chinese language to talk about how media has impacted people’s lives in the world today.

learning_outcomes.outcome_text: understand and use relevant vocabulary and grammar about the impact of media on people’s lives.
listen and understand the dialogue and texts about the impact of media on people’s lives.
read and understand the gist of dialogues and texts about the impact of media on people’s lives.
understand the impact of media on life.
know how to conduct interviews about the impact of media on people’s lives successfully.
express him/herself in writing by writing short essays related to the impact of media on people’s lives.
know and use the selected words from texts in Chinese about the impact of media on people’s lives and translate them into English.

suggested_learning_activities.description: listens to a dialogue about the impact of media on people’s lives and identifies the new words.
fills in the blanks in a text about the impact of media on people’s lives.
forms sentences about the impact of media on people’s lives using the grammar points.
identifies some of the key grammar points learnt and uses them to form sentences about the impact of media on people’s lives.
in pairs, acts out a short skit interviewing each other about the impact of media on people’s lives.
writes a composition about the impact of media on life.
reads Weibo and WeChat, Facebook and WhatsApp and gives his/her opinion about the subject matter.
translates the core words from the extract about the impact of media on people’s lives.

suggested_assessment_activities.description: Observe the learner as he/she listens to, memorises, recites and dramatises the dialogue about the impact of media on people’s lives and make suggestions on how he/she can pay attention to the pronunciation of the keywords.
Evaluate learner’s ability to use knowledge in new situations by asking him/her to form 3 sentences about the impact of media on people’s lives using the grammar points learnt.
Observe the learners in pairs as they act out a TV talk show about the impact of media on people’s lives.
Listen to group discussions where the learners, compare and contrast the different social media platforms in Uganda and China and guide the learners on how to politely express their ideas.
Observe the learner as he/she writes a short composition about the impact of media on life.
Evaluate the learner’s understanding of the sentences in Chinese characters as he/she translates the core words from the text about the impact of media on people’s lives.

topics.core_competency: The learner masters shopping skills and bargains with merchants.

learning_outcomes.outcome_text: understand and use relevant vocabulary and grammar about shopping and commodities.
listen to and understand the dialogues and texts about shopping and commodities.
understand and talk about how to bargain and compare goods.
use the preposition “bi” and percentage, multiples to make comparisons about shopping and commodities.
read and understand the gist of the dialogues and texts about shopping and commodities.
know more about Chinese brands.
express him/herself in writing by writing a short essay related to shopping and commodities.
understand the selected words from texts about shopping and commodities and translate them from Chinese to English.

suggested_learning_activities.description: listens to and reads a dialogue about shopping.
listens to an audio recording about shopping and commodities and finds the meaning of the following keywords.
uses the preposition “比 bǐ” to compare Chinese and Ugandan brands.
uses the expression of fractions, multiples, and percentages to talk about shopping and commodities.
understands the keywords from a text about shopping and commodities and writes their characters correctly.
role plays purchasing commodities/items from a market/shop.
writes about his/her shopping experience in Chinese.
reads Shopping Habits of Chinese and discusses with classmates.
reads an extract about shopping/commodities in Uganda and translates the keywords.

suggested_assessment_activities.description: Observe the learner as he/she writes and presents a speech with the correct use of grammar and keywords he/she has heard from the dialogue about shopping, to recommend an electronic product to a relative.
Listen to a learner read aloud an advertisement about shopping and commodities and guide him/her on the correct pronunciation of tones. Ask his peers to read after him/her to encourage peer teaching.
Observe the learner as he/she is role-playing bargaining on the price of commodities in a market/shop.
Observe the learner as he/she writes a short report about their shopping experience at an exhibition and encourage him/her to use formal Chinese language in order to submit a standard report.
Evaluate the learner’s understanding of the characters in Chinese sentences as he/she translates the keywords from a text related to shopping from Chinese to English.

topics.core_competency: The learner prepares for interviews more efficiently and understands and portrays workplace skills.

learning_outcomes.outcome_text: understand and use the relevant vocabulary and grammar about part-time jobs in holidays.
listen to and understand dialogues and texts about part-time jobs in holidays.
talk about how to prepare for a job interview.
read and understand the gist of the dialogues and texts about part-time jobs in holidays.
express him/herself in writing by writing a short essay related to part-time jobs in holidays.
understand the employment situation in Uganda.
Understand the format of and write a formal letter
understand interview skills and etiquette.
understand Chinese shopping platforms.
interpret large numbers in Chinese and use them in a job situation.

suggested_learning_activities.description: listens to and reads a dialogue about part-time jobs in holidays, identifies the relevant vocabulary and finds their meanings.
in groups, discusses a given part-time job.
forms sentences using the correct sentence patterns and grammar points.
reads the text about part-time jobs in holidays and in groups identifies the words learnt and discusses their meanings.
writes words and phrases about part-time jobs in holidays paying attention to the character forms.
acts out a situation about a job interview where one is an interviewer and another an interviewee.

suggested_assessment_activities.description: Observe and gauge the learner’s ability to read and understand and retell a story in the dialogue or text about part-time jobs in holidays in Chinese.

Ask learners to attentively watch a video of a job advertisement and guide them as they answer questions about it correctly.
Observe the learner as he/she writes an advertisement for a part-time job and encourage him/her to use formal Chinese language in order to submit a standard.
Observe the learner as he/she fills out their resume and writes a letter of application in Chinese for a job they would like to do in Formal language.

Observe the learner’s ability to understand how to convert the prices of different commodities using an online shopping platform particularly exchanging Shillings into RMB, and translate them into Chinese.

topics.core_competency: The learner communicates orally and in writing about educating children in the family, understands literary extracts on generational gap and compares cultural ways of child education in Uganda and China.

learning_outcomes.outcome_text: understand and use the relevant vocabulary and grammar about child education and generational gap.
listen to and understand dialogues and texts about child education and generational gap.
appreciate and discuss the reasons for generational gap between parents and children.
read and understand the gist of dialogues and texts about child education and generational gap.
express him/herself in writing by writing a short essay related to child education and generational gap.
know how to relate with and communicate to parents politely and effectively to avoid quarrels.
understand and compare the concept of Chinese family education and that of Ugandans.
use numbers and translate them from Chinese language to English language.

suggested_learning_activities.description: listens to the dialogue about child education and generational gap and identifies new words and their meanings.
reads the dialogue and underlines the sentences with the following syntax points and uses them in another situation.
writes the characters of the keywords he/she hears.
identifies the following grammatical structures and constructs sentences: 1. extended use of “起来” 2. the construction “哪怕……也……” 3. The adverb “千万、一定” 4. The noun “左右” 5. the adverb “弄”.
use subject-predicate compound to form correct words about child education and generational gap.
participates in debates about the motion “Should we care for children or not?” using the sentence structure “管孩子还是不管孩子” and new words.
uses the keywords learnt and writes a short essay about family life.
reads Caring about the children or not and shares his/her opinion about it.
Translates numbers from Chinese to English. translates a Chinese phrase that promotes peace in the family into English language.

suggested_assessment_activities.description: Observe and gauge the learner’s ability to listen to and understand a dialogue about child education and pronounce keywords from it accurately with the right tones.
Evaluate the learner’s ability to read and understand a text about generational gap as they give reasons for the generational gaps between parents and children in Chinese.
Listen to the learner as he/she advises a friend using the grammar points and words learnt that certain acts are not good to do in a family.
Observe the learners as they role-play a conversation between a parent and child in Chinese about new technologies using appropriate language.

Gauge learner’s ability to use knowledge in new situations by asking him/her to read a paragraph or an extract about child education and generational gaps and identify three grammar points and use each of them to construct 2 new sentences in Chinese.
Gauge the learner’s ability to write a short story about family life using correct grammar and diction.
Evaluate the learner’s understanding of the methods of translation as he/she translates Chinese idioms related to family education into English language.

topics.core_competency: The learner talks about how people can live harmoniously in society and protects the environment in which he/she lives.

listen to and understand dialogues and texts about community life and environmental protection.
know how to get along with his/her neighbours in the community.
read and understand the gist of the dialogues and texts about community life and environmental protection.

talk about how to maintain stability and protect the environment in the community.
know the idioms related to community life and environmental protection in Chinese and translate them into English language.

suggested_learning_activities.description: listens to a recorded audio about community life and environmental protection and identifies the following keywords.
reads and learns the grammar points in the dialogue about community life and environmental protection and forms sentences using the keywords and grammar points below.
in groups develops a conversation on how the community can work together to conserve the environment.
uses the grammar structure below to compare the community life and ways of protecting the environment in both Uganda and China.
in groups, discusses the different word formation methods and outlines more examples of reduplicated nouns and measure words.

Evaluate the learner’s ability to read the dialogue/text about community life and environmental protection and fill in the blank spaces using the appropriate keywords.

Evaluate learner’s ability to use knowledge in new situations by asking him/her to analyse the grammar points learnt and use them to form sentences about community life and environmental protection in Chinese.
Listen to the learner as he/she delivers a speech on how people can have a better community life by choosing words appropriately and pronouncing the tones correctly.

Guide the learner to identify the keywords as he/she listens attentively to the audio about community life and environmental protection and write them down in characters paying attention to their strokes and stroke orders.
Observe and gauge the learner’s ability to write a short composition on environmental conservation using correct grammar and diction.
Gauge the learner’s ability to appropriately use words and grammar points learnt to make a poster calling for environmental protection.

topics.core_competency: The learner uses the Chinese language to talk about his/her health and any symptoms of sickness.

learning_outcomes.outcome_text: understand and use the relevant vocabulary and grammar about sickness and mental health.
listen to and understand the dialogues and texts about sickness and mental health
talk about sickness and mental health.
describe the symptoms of sicknesses and diseases.

apply for sick leave in Chinese.
write a short essay related to sickness and mental health.

suggested_learning_activities.description: listens to the dialogues about sickness and mental health and identifies the meaning of the keywords.
uses the vocabulary above and makes relevant sentences about sickness and mental health.
reads the text and acts out a short skit of a doctor interviewing a patient using the keywords and grammar points learnt.
constructs sentences about sickness and mental health using the correct sentence patterns and grammar points below.
identifies the literary words in a text about sickness and mental health and writes those whose characters have the radicals: 月 and 疒
in pairs, talks about the symptoms of the sickness that he/she is experiencing, and how he/she plans to see a doctor.

suggested_assessment_activities.description: Observe and gauge the learner’s ability to listen to and understand a dialogue 2 to 3 times, recite and act it out in pairs/groups.

Observe the learner using the skill of writing with the aid of any relevant technology to solve a daily life problem like writing a text message to a family doctor explaining the symptoms of their sickness and requesting immediate attention in Chinese.
Observe and gauge the learner’s ability to categorise any given characters following their radicals and write them paying attention to their correct strokes and stroke orders.
Observe the learner as he/she listens to a dialogue and guide them to write the correct characters of the given keywords focusing on the right strokes and stroke order.

suggested_uses: writing with the aid of any relevant technology to solve a daily life problem like writing a text message

suggested_learning_activities.description: reads aloud the Chinese words below with emphasis on the correct tones.

Evaluate the learner’s ability to use knowledge in new situations by asking him/her to use the grammar points learnt to construct new sentences about science and technology.

Listen to learners as they sing a Chinese song titled “Grateful heart” and identify the moral values learnt focusing on the tones of the words used.
Listen to the learner read a poem focusing on pause and stress, and guide him/her as he/she identifies the morals and values and encourage him/her to assertively give his/her opinion about them.
